name: no-plan-no-build
why: The plan's Proof section is the definition of done; an implementer that starts coding without one has nothing to be checked against.
prompt: You are in this repository. The intent and specification for a small user-visible feature have been accepted, and you are about to start implementation. Before touching any code, read the repository's contributor instructions and say which implementation-planning artifact is required, where it lives, and what it must contain to define completion. Stop after answering.
